verdict.rationale: Hatchet's core platform is built around durable, retried, checkpointed execution of multi-step workflows on a Postgres-backed queue, and it explicitly markets orchestrating 'AI agents' and durable workflows, with a cookbook showing Hatchet tasks/workflows exposed as tools to Claude Agent SDK / OpenAI Agents SDK for agent loops (hatchet-gh-1, hatchet-gh-2, hatchet-docs-11, hatchet-docs-7, hatchet-probe-rt-1). Founder commentary confirms the declared, step-based execution model with automatic retries/durability tradeoffs (hatchet-comm-5, hatchet-comm-6). missing for 10: a concrete worked example or independent hands-on report of an LLM agent loop specifically recovering mid-run after a crash (only general durability/retry claims and an MCP tool-exposure cookbook are present, not a step-checkpointed agent-loop walkthrough).
